name: Delphi
tagline: The ancient oracle on the slopes of Mount Parnassus
summary: Ancient Greeks believed Delphi was the centre of the world, and came to consult the oracle of Apollo. Its temple, theatre and stadium climb a mountainside above an olive-filled valley, with one of Greece's best museums nearby.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn are ideal. Summer middays are hot; go early. Winter brings snow to nearby Parnassus ski slopes.
arrival: Buses from Athens take about 3 hours; many people come on a day tour or by car.
gettingAround: Walk; the village and the site are close together.
cashTip: Cards are common; carry euro notes for small tavernas, kiosks and island buses.
foodTip: Formaela cheese, roast lamb and mountain honey.
buyTip: Arachova rugs, honey and local cheese.

connections.note: KTEL buses; about 2.5 hours by car.
